Nothing else moves: the signal handlers, the owned registry and stage markers make no seam call on the happy path, and metrics.json gains interrupted only when the run is interrupted.
_derivation.rerecord_cd17: CD-17 (lane/v17-run-cd16, stacked on CD-16): 82 CoreV1Api read_namespace runchar calls added, by hand from the loop_schedule above and the settle record, not from the harness. NamespaceWatch.start() reads the namespace once after stream_identities (the window start); check() reads it after every loop sleep before the health line, at the top of every benchmark, maintenance and compaction round that runs, right after every benchmark round (the loop continues without a sleep), after every settle poll's sleep, and once before the by-name stream stop (cli/_sustained.py). In the window, from the schedule: start + 10 health probes (30..300) + round-1 probe before round 1; after-round-1 probe + 6 health probes (466.5..600) + maintenance-1 probe before maintenance 1; 5 (630..736.5) + round-2 probe before round 2; after-round-2 probe + 10 (898.1..1168.1) + round-3 probe before round 3; after-round-3 probe + maintenance-2 probe (the 1326.1 iteration) before maintenance 2; the compaction probe before compaction; 11 health probes (1519.1..1626.1, 1656.1..1776.1, 1800.0) before the window-end get_job_status: 52. The round due at 1626.1 is skipped (late) and gets no probe. Settle (continuous.settle.seconds 870, 30 s polls): 30 polls of three driver-log reads, a probe after each of the 29 sleeps, i.e. before every poll but the first: 29. One before the three delete_custom_resource of _stop_streams. Nothing else moves.
